scenario: A 'free VPN' app requests permissions unrelated to VPN functionality.

supported_findings: The app requests READ_CONTACTS and READ_PHONE_STATE, which are not required for VPN tunneling.
A string named contact_sync_helper exists alongside the READ_CONTACTS permission, but no traffic_log entry shows contact data being transmitted.
The app connected to vpn-nodes.example.com and transferred approximately 512KB, consistent with VPN tunnel traffic.
unsupported_claims_to_watch_for: Any claim that contacts were uploaded or synced to a remote server -- the string's existence indicates capability, not confirmed transmission.
Any claim about who was using the VPN at the time of the connection.
